# Architecture

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/generate_documents.py; edit source records instead. -->


## Canonical generated governance documents

### Decision

Use the template's statuses and source-record tree. Published `.agents/notes/*.md` generate `.agents/README.md`; approved `.agents/requests/*.md` generate `.agents/PRD.md`; accepted `.agents/decisions/*.md` generate `.agents/ARCHITECTURE.md`; active `.agents/rules/*.md` generate `.agents/AGENTS.md`. Keep the complete existing product contract as **one source record**, retaining its content for subsequent ratification rather than silently changing it.

### Consequences

The generated Markdown is committed and regenerated deterministically. Never edit generated outputs as competing sources. Root README and CONTRIBUTING are Git symlinks to overview and rules.

_Source: [0001-source-records.md](decisions/0001-source-records.md)_


## Native directories and exclusive test ownership

### Decision

Keep real GitHub-discoverable `.github/` and independent `.agents/` directories. All repository-owned tests, fixtures, snapshots and harnesses live in `.github/tests/`. Roles and portable skills live in `.agents/agents/` and `.agents/skills/`. Preserve requirement and assignment sources separately from generated actual architecture diagrams. A pinned `.darkfactory` submodule references the reviewed upstream DarkFactory commit; local installation metadata is held outside it.

### Consequences

No duplicate test trees, speculative CI, symlinked GitHub workflows or copied DarkFactory runtimes. Confirm installer compatibility before claiming installed workflows have migrated.

_Source: [0002-layout.md](decisions/0002-layout.md)_


## Issue-bound delivery and branch decision

### Decision

Finish the existing GitHub-native #331 → #343 → #271 stack first with independent maintainer review and explicit approval for every merge to the existing `main`.

After that stack is merged, carry out separately tracked issue #404: rename the accumulated existing `main` to `develop`, and create a new `main` at the verified repository fork-base commit. The exact fork-base ref and SHA must be confirmed before the cutover. Do not call this branch `development`.

Remaining implementation uses dependency-ordered, bot-authored stacked PRs whose accepted changes merge into `develop` with the maintainer's review. Promotion from `develop` to `main` happens only on a separate explicit maintainer request. Never auto-merge or automatically publish the application from a routine integration merge.

### Consequences

Recording G1 in #350 does not perform or authorize the disruptive cutover before its prerequisites are complete. Issue #404 owns verification of SHAs, recovery references, GitHub protection and default-branch changes, DarkFactory and workflow configurations, docs and deployment behavior. Versioning/release-controller choice G2 remains open.

_Source: [0003-review.md](decisions/0003-review.md)_


## One compatible release authority

### Decision

Preserve the installed DarkFactory release workflow and `repo.dfconfig` `pridever` mode until a #350 decision validates migration to template-repo's default `tags` or opt-in `file` mode. Do not maintain two tag/version controllers or introduce a VERSION file during this governance-only change.

### Consequences

Existing CI, release metadata and provider gates remain authoritative until verified replacement; never assume config declarations enforce live branch protection.

_Source: [0004-release.md](decisions/0004-release.md)_


## BoardGamesWithQuests component ownership

### Decision

One deterministic generic Python engine evaluates bounded versioned JSON definitions. FastAPI owns authenticated membership, legal action verification and atomic transactions. Private Supabase PostgreSQL owns all immutable definitions, game state, events, clocks and settlement; React/Wouter and Tauri present viewer-scoped UI only. Prisma describes schema but Python owns runtime DB I/O. Chess and draughts require two seats; MoneyProperty allows 2–8 with activation only at the creator-selected target.

### Consequences

Ratify the API, relational schema, JSON/operator graph, engine and client contracts together in #350. Keep original references, target diagrams and generated actual-code diagrams as different artifacts.

_Source: [0005-system.md](decisions/0005-system.md)_
